headline: RBC Capital Reiterates Outperform on Citigroup, Maintains $150 Price Target
Citigroup Delivers ‘Rare Clean Sweep’ With Best Quarterly Revenue in a Decade, Says Analyst
summary: Citigroup share price rose after strong Q2 results and positive analyst ratings. Revenue grew and expenses expected to increase slightly.
